standard.unit: Every governed Peshitta source token has exactly one certified alignment relation.

permittedRelations.DIRECT_LEXICAL_CORRESPONDENCE: Unique row-level lexical correspondence corroborated by the same concept in two or more evidence families.
permittedRelations.MULTIROW_LEXICAL_SPAN: One Syriac token corresponds to a bounded multirow expression; no false one-to-one choice is made.
permittedRelations.CONTEXTUAL_LEXICAL_CORRESPONDENCE: Best bounded lexical/contextual row supported by SEDRA and at least one displayed evidence family.
permittedRelations.MORPHOSYNTACTIC_BOUNDARY_SPAN: Occurrence morphology is mapped, but the foreign witnesses distribute or omit the Syriac unit; alignment is certified to its monotonic governed span.
permittedRelations.SOURCE_ORDER_BOUNDARY_SPAN: No compatible occurrence morphology is inherited across editions; the token is certified only to its monotonic governed span.
permittedRelations.VERSE_LEVEL_SYRIAC_UNIT: The verse contains no foreign row inside the governed boundary; the Syriac unit remains verse-aligned without a fabricated counterpart.

standard.exclusions: A certified span is not a claim of lexical equivalence and does not authorize an English gloss.
